title: Hearty Velvety Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring pork dumplings in a rich saffron sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is egg-free and uses a mother sauce base for added depth of flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, flour, saffron threads, salt, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, proof the yeast by mixing it with 1 tablespoon of warm water, then add it to the pork mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic, then cover it with plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, then roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Add the dumplings to the simmering sauce and cook for 15 minutes, until cooked through.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
